overview: Judicator Court is the legal and ritual‑judicial center of Ka Vethan, where Praesertum decrees are interpreted and enforced.
history: Founded during the earliest Akhevan era to formalize lineage law.
Void‑arcane tribunals were added to bind judgment to resonance.
Luclinite decree chambers expanded to support Praesertum governance.
Judicators became the highest interpreters of Akhevan civic law.
Modern Court remains the most authoritative legal institution on Luclin.
hooks: A decree chamber destabilizes during a ritual trial.
A Judicator requests assistance with a corrupted verdict echo.
A lineage dispute escalates into arcane conflict.
A Praesertum directive alters legal protocol unexpectedly.
